items.q: Events A and B are mutually exclusive, with P(A) = 0,3 and P(B) = 0,5. What is P(A or B)?
items.qAf: Gebeure A en B is wedersyds uitsluitend, met P(A) = 0,3 en P(B) = 0,5. Wat is P(A of B)?
items.explain: For mutually exclusive events, P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) = 0,3 + 0,5 = 0,8.
items.explainAf: Vir wedersyds uitsluitende gebeure is P(A of B) = P(A) + P(B) = 0,3 + 0,5 = 0,8.

items.q: Events A and B are independent, with P(A) = 1/2 and P(B) = 1/3. What is P(A and B)?
items.qAf: Gebeure A en B is onafhanklik, met P(A) = 1/2 en P(B) = 1/3. Wat is P(A en B)?

items.q: Two fair coins are tossed. What is the probability of two heads?
items.qAf: Twee regverdige munte word gegooi. Wat is die waarskynlikheid van twee koppe?
items.explain: Outcomes: HH, HT, TH, TT. Only HH works, so P = 1/4.
items.explainAf: Uitkomste: KK, KS, SK, SS. Slegs KK werk, dus P = 1/4.
